story_theme_en: Lin and Mali order a pizza together. Lin eats 3/8 of the whole pizza. Mali eats 2/8 of the pizza. How much of the pizza did they eat together? How much of the pizza is left?
helper_tip: Fractions with the same denominator can be added or subtracted. Add or subtract the numerators only.
hint_th: เศษส่วนที่มีส่วนเท่ากัน บวกลบตัวเศษได้เลย ส่วนคงที่

visual_blocks.title: Story
visual_blocks.content: Lin and Mali order a pizza together. Lin eats 3/8 of the whole pizza. Mali eats 2/8 of the pizza. How much of the pizza did they eat together? How much of the pizza is left?

data.content_en: Lin and Mali order a pizza together. Lin eats 3/8 of the whole pizza. Mali eats 2/8 of the pizza. How much of the pizza did they eat together? How much of the pizza is left?

visual_blocks.title: Think
visual_blocks.content: Step 1: Add what they ate → 3/8 + 2/8 = 5/8 | Step 2: Find what is left → 8/8 - 5/8 = 3/8

data.content_en: Step 1: Add what they ate → 3/8 + 2/8 = 5/8 | Step 2: Find what is left → 8/8 - 5/8 = 3/8

steps.label: Step 1: Add the fractions eaten
steps.story_connection: 3/8 + 2/8 = 5/8 (add the numerators, denominator stays the same)

steps.label: Step 2: Find the remaining fraction
steps.story_connection: 8/8 - 5/8 = 3/8 (subtract the numerators, denominator stays the same)

visual_blocks.title: Try It
visual_blocks.question: A cake is cut into 9 equal pieces. Lin eats 4/9 of the cake. Mali eats 2/9 of the cake. How much do they eat in total? How much is left?

data.question: A cake is cut into 9 equal pieces. Lin eats 4/9 of the cake. Mali eats 2/9 of the cake. How much do they eat in total? How much is left?

common_mistakes: Forgetting that denominators must be the same to add or subtract
hints: Fractions that can be added or subtracted must have equal denominators.

key_vocabulary.definition_en: The top number of a fraction showing the number of parts
The bottom number of a fraction showing total parts
